name: addmedia
description: AddMedia — live chat, talkback and media on every web page.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix worker install && npm --prefix panel install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix worker run db:local && npm --prefix worker run dev
scripts.build:ext: cd panel && VITE_API_BASE=${API_BASE:-https://addmedia.noaplate.com} npx vite build --mode extension --outDir ../extension/panel --emptyOutDir
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:ext
